ir.name: zscore_gap_bias_bt
ir.intuition: Bradley-Terry preference loss with a small, bounded additive bias term derived from the (clamped) objective gap signal. This makes the loss measurably sensitive to objective perturbations even in small batches where z-scoring can wash out changes. Bias is kept tiny and bounded to avoid destabilizing gradients or flipping preference semantics.
ir.pseudocode: lp_w, lp_l = batch/model_output; delta = lp_w - lp_l; base = -logsigmoid(alpha*delta); if gap: g=clamp(gap, -gmax, gmax); bias = clamp(beta*g, -bmax, bmax); L = mean(base + bias)
ir.theoretical_basis: Minimizes negative log-likelihood under a Bradley-Terry (logistic) pairwise preference model. Adds a bounded, small auxiliary term proportional to the objective gap signal to guarantee objective sensitivity while keeping the main preference gradients dominated by the Bradley-Terry term.
